Hyderabad Task Force Cracks Down on Stale Seafood and Meat Rackets

The Hyderabad Task Force has busted two separate seafood and meat supply rackets in the city, arresting four individuals and seizing large quantities of adulterated products. The rackets involve selling stale seafood and mixing beef with goat meat. The authorities have taken action after receiving complaints from citizens and conducting raids by the H-FAST team.
